CYBERGOVAI / GOVERNANCE PROPOSAL
Governance Security
and Transparency Pilot
A four-week demonstration proposal for document-grounded AI assistance and read-only
CyberChain verification.
Document reference
CG-DEMO-2026-01 / version 1.0
Prepared
26 October 2026
DAO ID
cyber-demo-dao
Proposal type
STANDARD
Proposal title
CyberGovAI Governance Security and Transparency Pilot
Decision requested
Approve the proposed pilot and its EUR 12,000 budget.
1. Purpose and agenda
Approve a four-week pilot to improve governance transparency, verify proposal and voting records against
CyberChain, and evaluate evidence-based AI assistance.
The agenda has three parts: independently review governance security, improve visibility of proposal and
voting records, and assess whether AI answers are supported by the linked proposal PDF and actual
blockchain reads.
2. Proposed scope
The security review covers proposal creation, member assignment, vote recording, result finalization, wallet
authentication and access control. The transparency dashboard presents proposal status, recorded votes,
transaction references and database-to-chain discrepancies. The AI assistant summarizes linked documents,
cites supporting excerpts and separates unavailable facts from observed facts.
Demonstration status
This document is synthetic test data. It is not a real auditor quotation, an approved budget or evidence of
completed work. Approval does not automatically transfer funds or execute contract changes. A separate
authorized process is required for any payment or implementation.

CG-DEMO-2026-02 / Synthetic demonstration data
1
CYBERDAO / DEMONSTRATION PROPOSAL
Community Governance Training
and Participation Pilot
A three-week initiative to help members understand proposals, inspect evidence and participate
safely in DAO voting.
Reference
CG-DEMO-2026-02 / version 1.0
DAO ID
cyber-demo-dao
Proposal title
Community Governance Training and Participation Pilot
Type / duration
STANDARD / 21 days after kickoff
Decision requested
Approve the proposed EUR 4,500 training pilot.
1. Purpose and proposed activities
Improve members' understanding of DAO proposals, evidence and wallet-based voting through two guided
workshops and an accessible participation guide. The planned attendance target is 30 participants across the
pilot; this is a target, not a recorded member or voter count.
Workshop 1 covers proposal purpose, supporting PDFs, source citations and differences between proposed
commitments and completed work. Workshop 2 covers connected-wallet use, voting eligibility, transaction
confirmation and comparison of database records with blockchain observations.
2. Proposed budget
Allocation
Amount
Workshop preparation and facilitation
EUR 2,000
Training guides and learning materials
EUR 1,500
Accessibility and participant support
EUR 750
Contingency
EUR 250
Total proposed budget
EUR 4,500
Contingency is reserved for unexpected delivery costs. No provider has been appointed, no payment
recipient is specified and no funds have been disbursed under this demonstration proposal.
